local json = require("json")


-- ================================================================
-- 1. 상수 및 설정
-- ================================================================

local STATE_KEY    = "aff_data"
local BACKUP_KEY   = "aff_backups"
local HTML_KEY     = "aff_html"

local MARKER_OPEN  = "|aff_mod\n"
local MARKER_CLOSE = "\naff_mod|"
local MARKER_PATTERN = "|aff_mod[%s%S]-aff_mod|"

local REPORT_PATTERN = '{%s*"[Ee]ntity".-"[Ss]ocial%s+event"%s*:%s*".-event"%s*}'

local MAX_BACKUPS = 10

local DEFAULTS = {
    MAX_CORE    = 3,
    RECENT_LOOK = 6,
    DETAIL_THR  = 1.0,
    DETAIL_MIN  = 3,
    MEMORY_CAP  = 20,
    IMP_STEP    = 5.4,
}

local function get_setting(triggerId, gvar_key, fallback)
    local raw = getGlobalVar(triggerId, gvar_key)
    if not raw or raw == "" then return fallback end
    local num = tonumber(raw)
    return num or fallback
end

local function load_settings(triggerId)
    return {
        max_core         = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_maxCore",     DEFAULTS.MAX_CORE),
        recent_lookback  = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_recentTurns", DEFAULTS.RECENT_LOOK),
        detail_threshold = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_detailThr",   DEFAULTS.DETAIL_THR),
        detail_min       = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_detailMin",   DEFAULTS.DETAIL_MIN),
        memorycap        = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_memoryCap",   DEFAULTS.MEMORY_CAP),
        impstep          = get_setting(triggerId, "toggle_aff_impStep",     DEFAULTS.IMP_STEP),
    }
end

local DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    firstrange = 0.2,
    oblivion   = 0.7,
    firstimp   = 0.5,
    longtime1  = 0.2,
    longtime2  = 0.4,
    memorycap  = 20,
    impstep    = 5.4,
}

local OPINION_SCALE = {
    minor_approval  =  1,
    approval        =  2,
    major_approval  =  3,
    profound_impact =  4,
    paradigm_shift  =  5,
    minor_friction  = -1,
    friction        = -2,
    major_friction  = -3,
    enmity          = -4,
    blood_feud      = -5,
}

local POS_IMPRESSIONS = {
    { category = "Neutral(+0/6)",              desc = "Currently feeling neutral towards the user, neither particularly favorable nor unfavorable." },
    { category = "Slightly Positive(+1/6)",    desc = "Currently feeling mildly favorable towards the user. Finds user's presence somewhat pleasant and tolerable. May show small gestures of goodwill." },
    { category = "Positive(+2/6)",             desc = "Currently feeling positive towards the user. Genuinely enjoys interactions with user and values their presence. Willing to offer help or cooperation." },
    { category = "Very Positive(+3/6)",        desc = "Currently feeling strongly favorable towards the user. Actively seeks opportunities to interact with or assist user. Holds user in high regard and trusts them considerably." },
    { category = "Deeply Appreciative(+4/6)",  desc = "Currently feeling profound appreciation towards the user. Views user as someone exceptionally important or valuable. May prioritize user's needs and demonstrate strong loyalty." },
    { category = "Devoted(+5/6)",              desc = "Currently feeling intense devotion towards the user. Experiences strong emotional investment in user's wellbeing. May act irrationally in user's favor or make significant sacrifices." },
    { category = "Unwavering Allegiance(+6/6)",desc = "Currently feeling absolute commitment towards the user. Emotionally bound to user's fate. Will defend or support user even against reason or self-interest." },
}

local NEG_IMPRESSIONS = {
    { category = "Neutral(-0/6)",              desc = "Currently feeling neutral towards the user, neither particularly favorable nor unfavorable." },
    { category = "Slightly Negative(-1/6)",    desc = "Currently feeling mild discomfort towards the user. Finds user's presence somewhat irritating or unpleasant. May show subtle signs of displeasure." },
    { category = "Negative(-2/6)",             desc = "Currently feeling negative towards the user. Actively dislikes interactions with user and avoids them when possible. Harbors growing frustration or annoyance." },
    { category = "Very Negative(-3/6)",        desc = "Currently feeling strongly unfavorable towards the user. Holds significant resentment or distrust. May actively work against user's interests or refuse cooperation." },
    { category = "Hostile(-4/6)",              desc = "Currently feeling intense hostility towards the user. Views user as a threat or deeply offensive presence. May seek to undermine, harm, or drive away user." },
    { category = "Loathing(-5/6)",             desc = "Currently feeling profound hatred towards the user. Experiences visceral negative reactions to user's presence. May obsessively seek retribution or user's downfall." },
    { category = "Irreconcilable Enmity(-6/6)",desc = "Currently consumed by hatred for the user. Views user's existence as intolerable. Will pursue user's destruction or suffering regardless of consequences." },
}


-- ================================================================
-- 2. 디버그 유틸리티
-- [FIX] onStart/onOutput 로그를 별도 키로 분리
-- ================================================================

local _dbg_log_key = "aff_debug_log"

local function dbg(triggerId, step, detail)
    detail = detail or ""
    local msg = "[" .. step .. "]"
    if detail ~= "" then msg = msg .. " " .. detail end

    local log
    if step == "START" then
        if detail:find("onStart") then
            _dbg_log_key = "aff_debug_log_start"
        elseif detail:find("onOutput") then
            _dbg_log_key = "aff_debug_log_output"
        else
            _dbg_log_key = "aff_debug_log"
        end
        log = {}
    else
        local raw = getState(triggerId, _dbg_log_key)
        local ok, res = pcall(json.decode, raw or "")
        log = (ok and type(res) == "table") and res or {}
    end
    table.insert(log, { step = step, detail = detail, msg = msg })

    local ok_enc, encoded = pcall(json.encode, log)
    if ok_enc then setState(triggerId, _dbg_log_key, encoded) end

    setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_step",   step)
    setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_detail", detail)
    setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_last",   msg)
    print("[Affection DBG] " .. msg)
end

local function dbg_error(triggerId, step, detail)
    dbg(triggerId, "ERROR:" .. step, detail)
    alertError(triggerId, "[" .. step .. "] " .. (detail or ""))
end


-- ================================================================
-- 3. 상태 관리
-- [FIX] _current_scan 임시 필드 처리
-- ================================================================

local function load_state(triggerId)
    local raw = getState(triggerId, STATE_KEY)
    if not raw or raw == "" or raw == "NILNILNIL" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if not data.config then data.config = DEFAULT_CONFIG
    else
        for k, v in pairs(DEFAULT_CONFIG) do
            if data.config[k] == nil then data.config[k] = v end
        end
    end
    if not data.names then data.names = {} end
    if not data.core_names then data.core_names = {} end
    if not data.memory then data.memory = {} end
    if not data.relationship then data.relationship = {} end
    if not data.appearance_log then data.appearance_log = {} end
    data._current_scan = nil  -- 임시 필드 항상 초기화
    return data
end

-- [FIX] _current_scan 제거 후 저장, 복원
local function save_state(triggerId, state)
    local temp = state._current_scan
    state._current_scan = nil

    local ok, result = pcall(json.encode, state)
    state._current_scan = temp  -- 복원

    if not ok then
        local fields = {"config", "names", "core_names", "memory", "relationship", "appearance_log"}
        local diagnosis = {}
        for _, field in ipairs(fields) do
            local f_ok, f_err = pcall(json.encode, state[field] or "nil")
            if f_ok then
                table.insert(diagnosis, field .. "=OK")
            else
                table.insert(diagnosis, field .. "=FAIL(" .. tostring(f_err):sub(1, 50) .. ")")
            end
        end
        local diag_str = table.concat(diagnosis, ", ")
        dbg_error(triggerId, "SAVE_STATE",
            "json encode failed: " .. tostring(result):sub(1, 100)
            .. " | DIAGNOSIS: " .. diag_str)
        error("save_state failed: " .. tostring(result))
    end
    setState(triggerId, STATE_KEY, result)
end

local function ensure_state(triggerId)
    local state = load_state(triggerId)
    if not state then
        state = {
            config         = DEFAULT_CONFIG,
            names          = {},
            core_names     = {},
            memory         = {},
            relationship   = {},
            appearance_log = {},
            _current_scan  = nil,
        }
        save_state(triggerId, state)
    end
    return state
end


-- ================================================================
-- 4. 시간 계수 T(t)
-- ================================================================

local function T(t, cfg)
    local a = cfg.firstrange
    local b = cfg.oblivion
    local c = cfg.firstimp
    local d = cfg.longtime1
    local e = cfg.longtime2

    if t < a then
        return ((d - c) / (a * a)) * (t * t) + c
    elseif t < b then
        return ((e - d) / (b - a)) * t + (d - a * (e - d) / (b - a))
    else
        local denom = (b - 1) * (b - 1)
        return ((e - 1) / denom) * (t * t) - (2 * (e - 1) / denom) * t + (1 + (e - 1) / denom)
    end
end


-- ================================================================
-- 5. 기억 계산
-- ================================================================

local function calc_weighted(memory, cfg)
    local result = {}
    local n = #memory
    if n == 0 then return result end
    for i, frag in ipairs(memory) do
        result[i] = frag.scale * T(i / n, cfg)
    end
    return result
end

local function sum_weighted(memory, cfg)
    local w = calc_weighted(memory, cfg)
    local total = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(w) do total = total + v end
    return total
end

local function rank_memories(memory, cfg)
    local weighted = calc_weighted(memory, cfg)
    local ranked = {}
    for i, w in ipairs(weighted) do
        table.insert(ranked, { idx = i, weight = w, abs_weight = math.abs(w) })
    end
    table.sort(ranked, function(a, b) return a.abs_weight > b.abs_weight end)
    return ranked
end


-- ================================================================
-- 6. 인물 관리
-- ================================================================

local function ensure_character(state, name)
    for _, n in ipairs(state.names) do
        if n == name then return false end
    end
    table.insert(state.names, name)
    state.memory[name] = {}
    state.relationship[name] = {
        relationship = "None",
        description  = "Not yet defined. Recommend immediate definition.",
        reason       = "Not yet defined",
    }
    return true
end

local function remove_character(state, name)
    for i, n in ipairs(state.names) do
        if n == name then
            table.remove(state.names, i)
            state.memory[name] = nil
            state.relationship[name] = nil
            for j, cn in ipairs(state.core_names) do
                if cn == name then
                    table.remove(state.core_names, j)
                    break
                end
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function set_core(state, name, settings)
    ensure_character(state, name)
    for _, cn in ipairs(state.core_names) do
        if cn == name then return false, "already core" end
    end
    local max_core = (settings and settings.max_core) or DEFAULTS.MAX_CORE
    if #state.core_names >= max_core then
        return false, "core full"
    end
    table.insert(state.core_names, name)
    return true, "ok"
end

local function unset_core(state, name)
    for i, cn in ipairs(state.core_names) do
        if cn == name then
            table.remove(state.core_names, i)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function is_core(state, name)
    for _, cn in ipairs(state.core_names) do
        if cn == name then return true end
    end
    return false
end


-- ================================================================
-- 7. 등장 기록 + NPC 주요도 분류
-- ================================================================

local function push_appearance(state, names, settings)
    if not state.appearance_log then state.appearance_log = {} end
    if type(names) ~= "table" then return end

    local clean = {}
    for _, v in ipairs(names) do
        if type(v) == "string" then
            table.insert(clean, v)
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.appearance_log, clean)

    local lookback = (settings and settings.recent_lookback) or DEFAULTS.RECENT_LOOK
    local max_records = lookback * 3
    while #state.appearance_log > max_records do
        table.remove(state.appearance_log, 1)
    end
end

local function classify_npcs(state, current_names, settings)
    local core     = {}
    local on_scene = {}
    local recent   = {}
    local dormant  = {}

    local current_set = {}
    if current_names and type(current_names) == "table" then
        for _, name in ipairs(current_names) do
            current_set[name] = true
        end
    end

    local lookback = (settings and settings.recent_lookback) or DEFAULTS.RECENT_LOOK
    local recent_set = {}
    local log = state.appearance_log or {}
    local start_idx = math.max(1, #log - lookback + 1)
    local end_idx   = #log

    for i = start_idx, end_idx do
        if type(log[i]) == "table" then
            for _, name in ipairs(log[i]) do
                recent_set[name] = true
            end
        end
    end

    for _, name in ipairs(state.names) do
        if is_core(state, name) then
            table.insert(core, name)
        elseif current_set[name] then
            table.insert(on_scene, name)
        elseif recent_set[name] and state.memory[name] then
            table.insert(recent, name)
        else
            table.insert(dormant, name)
        end
    end

    return core, on_scene, recent, dormant
end


-- ================================================================
-- 8. 기억 추가 / 관계 변경
-- ================================================================

local function add_memory(state, name, opinion_key, title, detail, time)
    local key = string.lower(opinion_key)
    local amount = OPINION_SCALE[key]
    if not amount then
        for k, v in pairs(OPINION_SCALE) do
            if string.find(key, k, 1, true) then
                amount = v
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not amount then return false end

    ensure_character(state, name)
    local mem = state.memory[name]
    local cap = state.config.memorycap

    if #mem >= cap then
        local weighted = calc_weighted(mem, state.config)
        local min_idx = 1
        local min_abs = math.abs(weighted[1])
        for i = 2, #weighted do
            local abs_v = math.abs(weighted[i])
            if abs_v < min_abs then
                min_idx = i
                min_abs = abs_v
            end
        end
        table.remove(mem, min_idx)
    end

    table.insert(mem, {
        scale  = amount,
        title  = title or "",
        detail = detail or "",
        time   = time or "unknown",
    })
    return true
end

local function change_relationship(state, name, new_rel, desc, reason)
    ensure_character(state, name)
    state.relationship[name] = {
        relationship = new_rel,
        description  = desc,
        reason       = reason,
    }
end


-- ================================================================
-- 9. 이름 정규화 유틸리티
-- [FIX] parse_reports(섹션 10)보다 앞에 배치 (Lua 스코프)
-- ================================================================

local function normalize_name(name)
    if not name then return "" end
    local n = name:gsub("%-", "")
    n = n:gsub("%s+", "")
    return n:lower()
end

local function match_known_name(raw_name, known_names)
    if not raw_name or raw_name == "" then return raw_name end

    for _, known in ipairs(known_names) do
        if known == raw_name then return known end
    end

    local norm_raw = normalize_name(raw_name)
    for _, known in ipairs(known_names) do
        if normalize_name(known) == norm_raw then
            return known
        end
    end

    for _, known in ipairs(known_names) do
        local norm_known = normalize_name(known)
        if norm_raw:find(norm_known, 1, true) or norm_known:find(norm_raw, 1, true) then
            return known
        end
    end

    return raw_name:gsub("%-", "")
end


-- ================================================================
-- 10. 응답 파싱
-- [FIX] Entity 이름에 match_known_name 정규화 적용
-- ================================================================

local function parse_reports(triggerId, state)
    local full_chat = getFullChat(triggerId)
    if #full_chat < 1 then return false end

    local cur_chat = full_chat[#full_chat].data

    -- [방어] 모델이 echoed한 태그 블록 제거
    cur_chat = cur_chat:gsub("<social_report_instruction>.-</social_report_instruction>", "")
    cur_chat = cur_chat:gsub("<social_dynamics>.-</social_dynamics>", "")

    -- [방어] ```json ... ``` 마크다운 블록 언래핑
    cur_chat = cur_chat:gsub("```json%s*", "")
    cur_chat = cur_chat:gsub("```%s*", "")

    local found_any = false
    local report_count = 0

    -- 대소문자 무시 필드 접근 헬퍼
    local function get_field(tbl, ...)
        for _, key in ipairs({...}) do
            if tbl[key] ~= nil then return tbl[key] end
        end
        -- 대소문자 무시 fallback
        local keys = {...}
        for tbl_key, val in pairs(tbl) do
            local lower = tbl_key:lower()
            for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
                if lower == key:lower() then return val end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    for target in cur_chat:gmatch(REPORT_PATTERN) do
        report_count = report_count + 1
        local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, target)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
            dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_SKIP", "#" .. report_count .. " json decode failed")
            goto continue
        end

        local raw_entity  = get_field(data, "Entity", "entity", "Name", "name")
        local event_type  = get_field(data, "Social event", "social event", "Social_event", "event")

        if not raw_entity or not event_type then
            dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_SKIP", "#" .. report_count .. " missing Entity/Social event")
            goto continue
        end

        raw_entity = tostring(raw_entity)
        local entity = match_known_name(raw_entity, state.names)
        event_type = tostring(event_type):lower()
        local time_label = tostring(get_field(data, "Time", "time") or "unknown")

        -- [FIX] 미등록 이름 무시: state.names에 없으면 스킵
        -- 메인모델은 이름 규칙을 안 지키는 경우가 많으므로,
        -- scan_current_turn(보조모델)이 등록한 이름만 허용
        local entity_known = false
        for _, n in ipairs(state.names) do
            if n == entity then entity_known = true; break end
        end
        if not entity_known then
            dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_SKIP_UNKNOWN", "#" .. report_count .. " unknown entity: '" .. entity .. "' (raw: '" .. raw_entity .. "')")
            goto continue
        end

        if raw_entity ~= entity then
            dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_NAME_FIX", "#" .. report_count .. " '" .. raw_entity .. "' → '" .. entity .. "'")
        end

        dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_REPORT",
            "#" .. report_count .. " entity=" .. entity
            .. " type=" .. event_type
            .. " time=" .. time_label)

        if event_type:find("opinion") then
            local scale_key = get_field(data, "Scale", "scale", "Context", "context")
            local title     = get_field(data, "Title", "title") or ""
            local detail    = get_field(data, "Detail", "detail") or get_field(data, "Reason", "reason") or ""
            local reason    = get_field(data, "Reason", "reason") or get_field(data, "Detail", "detail") or ""

            if scale_key then
                if (not title or title == "") and reason ~= "" then
                    title = reason
                end

                scale_key  = tostring(scale_key)
                title      = tostring(title)
                detail     = tostring(detail)

                local success = add_memory(state, entity, scale_key, title, detail, time_label)
                if success then
                    dbg(triggerId, "MEMORY_ADDED", entity .. " scale=" .. scale_key .. " title=" .. title:sub(1, 30))
                else
                    dbg_error(triggerId, "PARSE_OPINION", "Invalid scale key: " .. scale_key)
                end
                found_any = true
            end

        elseif event_type:find("relationship") then
            local context = get_field(data, "Context", "context")
            local rel_detail = get_field(data, "Detail", "detail")
            local rel_reason = get_field(data, "Reason", "reason")

            if type(context) == "table" then
                local new_rel = context.new or context.New or context["new"] or context["New"]
                if new_rel and rel_detail and rel_reason then
                    change_relationship(state, entity, tostring(new_rel), tostring(rel_detail), tostring(rel_reason))
                    dbg(triggerId, "REL_CHANGED", entity .. " → " .. tostring(new_rel):sub(1, 30))
                    found_any = true
                else
                    dbg_error(triggerId, "PARSE_REL", "Missing fields in rel change: " .. tostring(target):sub(1, 80))
                end
            else
                dbg_error(triggerId, "PARSE_REL", "Context not table: " .. tostring(target):sub(1, 80))
            end
        end

        ::continue::
    end

    dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_SUMMARY", report_count .. " reports found, applied=" .. tostring(found_any))
    return found_any
end


-- ================================================================
-- 11. 인상 계산
-- ================================================================

local function calc_impression(state, name)
    local mem = state.memory[name]
    if not mem or #mem == 0 then
        return POS_IMPRESSIONS[1].category, POS_IMPRESSIONS[1].desc, 0
    end

    local total = sum_weighted(mem, state.config)
    local step = state.config.impstep
    local impressions, raw_index

    if total >= 0 then
        impressions = POS_IMPRESSIONS
        raw_index = math.floor((total + step * 0.5) / step)
    else
        impressions = NEG_IMPRESSIONS
        raw_index = math.floor((math.abs(total) + step * 0.5) / step)
    end

    local idx = math.min(raw_index, #impressions - 1) + 1
    local percent = math.abs(total) / (idx * 5.5)
    percent = math.min(percent, 1.0)

    return impressions[idx].category, impressions[idx].desc, percent
end


-- ================================================================
-- 12. 기억 상세 문자열 생성
-- ================================================================

local function format_memories(state, name, settings)
    local mem = state.memory[name]
    if not mem or #mem == 0 then return "" end

    local ranked = rank_memories(mem, state.config)

    local threshold = (settings and settings.detail_threshold) or DEFAULTS.DETAIL_THR
    local min_count = (settings and settings.detail_min) or DEFAULTS.DETAIL_MIN

    local above_count = 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(ranked) do
        if entry.abs_weight >= threshold then
            above_count = above_count + 1
        end
    end

    local detail_count = math.max(above_count, math.min(min_count, #ranked))

    local lines = {}
    for rank, entry in ipairs(ranked) do
        local frag = mem[entry.idx]
        local sign = frag.scale >= 0 and "+" or ""
        local time_str = frag.time or "?"

        if rank <= detail_count then
            local detail_part = ""
            if frag.detail and frag.detail ~= "" then
                detail_part = " — " .. frag.detail
            end
            table.insert(lines, string.format(
                "  %d. [%s] %s%s (%s%d)",
                rank, time_str,
                frag.title or "(untitled)", detail_part,
                sign, frag.scale
            ))
        else
            table.insert(lines, string.format(
                "  %d. [%s] %s (%s%d)",
                rank, time_str,
                frag.title or "(untitled)",
                sign, frag.scale
            ))
        end
    end

    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end


-- ================================================================
-- 13. 현재 턴 이름 탐지
-- [FIX] return 대신 state._current_scan에 직접 기록
--       push_appearance도 scan 내부에서 호출
-- ================================================================

local scan_current_turn = async(function(triggerId, state, settings)
    dbg(triggerId, "SCAN_START", "1턴 스캔 시작")
    state._current_scan = {}  -- 실패 시 빈 배열

    local known_names_str = (#state.names > 0) and json.encode(state.names) or "[]"
    local persona_name = getPersonaName(triggerId)

    local full_chat = getFullChat(triggerId)
    if #full_chat < 1 then return end

    local chat_log = {}
    local start_idx = math.max(1, #full_chat - 1)

--- TEXT ---

    end

    -- [FIX] return 대신 state에 직접 기록 + push_appearance도 여기서

local function load_backups(triggerId)
    local raw = getState(triggerId, BACKUP_KEY)
    if not raw or raw == "" then return {} end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return {} end
    return data
end

local function save_backups(triggerId, backups)
    local ok, result = pcall(json.encode, backups)
    if not ok then
        dbg(triggerId, "BACKUP_ENCODE_FAIL", tostring(result))
        return
    end
    setState(triggerId, BACKUP_KEY, result)
end

local function backup_save(triggerId, timestamp_id)
    local state = load_state(triggerId)
    if not state then return end

    local backups = load_backups(triggerId)
    backups[timestamp_id] = {
        names          = state.names,
        core_names     = state.core_names,
        memory         = state.memory,
        relationship   = state.relationship,
        appearance_log = state.appearance_log,
    }

    local keys = {}
    for k in pairs(backups) do table.insert(keys, k) end
    table.sort(keys)
    while #keys > MAX_BACKUPS do
        backups[table.remove(keys, 1)] = nil
    end

    save_backups(triggerId, backups)
end

local function backup_load(triggerId, timestamp_id)
    local backups = load_backups(triggerId)
    local snapshot = backups and backups[timestamp_id]
    if not snapshot then
        dbg_error(triggerId, "BACKUP_LOAD", "No snapshot for ID " .. tostring(timestamp_id))
        return false
    end

    for k in pairs(backups) do
        if tonumber(k) > tonumber(timestamp_id) then
            backups[k] = nil
        end
    end
    save_backups(triggerId, backups)

    local state = ensure_state(triggerId)
    state.names          = snapshot.names or {}
    state.core_names     = snapshot.core_names or {}
    state.memory         = snapshot.memory or {}
    state.relationship   = snapshot.relationship or {}
    state.appearance_log = snapshot.appearance_log or {}
    save_state(triggerId, state)
    return true
end

local function guard_backup(triggerId)
    local full_chat = getFullChat(triggerId)
    if #full_chat < 2 then return false end

    local recent_ts = getChatVar(triggerId, "aff_ts_recent")
    local ts_list   = getState(triggerId, "aff_ts_list")
    if not recent_ts or not ts_list then return false end

    local stamp = string.match(full_chat[#full_chat].data, "<curchatID:(%d+):curchatID>")
    if not stamp then
        stamp = string.match(full_chat[#full_chat - 1].data, "<curchatID:(%d+):curchatID>")
    end
    if not stamp then return false end

    if recent_ts ~= stamp then
        local restored = backup_load(triggerId, stamp)
        if restored then
            setChatVar(triggerId, "aff_ts_recent", stamp)
            alertNormal(triggerId, "그리고, 세계가 뒤집혔다.")
        end
        return restored
    end
    return false
end

function onOutput(triggerId)
    local current_step = "init"
    dbg(triggerId, "START", "onOutput 진입")
    local ok, err = pcall(function()

        current_step = "getFullChat()"
        local full_chat = getFullChat(triggerId)
        if #full_chat < 1 then
            dbg(triggerId, "ABORT", "full_chat 비어있음")
            return
        end
        dbg(triggerId, "CHAT_LOADED", "chat_len=" .. #full_chat .. " last_role=" .. full_chat[#full_chat].role)

        current_step = "strip_markers(prev)"
        if #full_chat > 1 and full_chat[#full_chat - 1].role == "user" then
            full_chat[#full_chat - 1].data = strip_markers(full_chat[#full_chat - 1].data)
        end

        current_step = "ensure_state()"
        local state = ensure_state(triggerId)

        current_step = "load_settings()"
        local settings = load_settings(triggerId)
        state.config.memorycap = settings.memorycap
        state.config.impstep   = settings.impstep

        current_step = "parse_reports()"
        local parsed = parse_reports(triggerId, state)
        dbg(triggerId, "PARSE_DONE", "reports_found=" .. tostring(parsed))

        current_step = "save_state()"
        save_state(triggerId, state)

        current_step = "timestamp()"
        local ts_id = tostring(os.time())
        local timestamp_tag = '<curchatID:' .. ts_id .. ':curchatID>'

        if full_chat[#full_chat].role == "char" then
            current_step = "ts_list_update()"
            local raw_list = getState(triggerId, "aff_ts_list")
            local ok_list, ts_list = pcall(json.decode, raw_list or "")
            if not ok_list or type(ts_list) ~= "table" then ts_list = {} end
            table.insert(ts_list, ts_id)
            setState(triggerId, "aff_ts_list", json.encode(ts_list))
            setChatVar(triggerId, "aff_ts_recent", ts_id)

            current_step = "backup_save()"
            backup_save(triggerId, ts_id)
            full_chat[#full_chat].data = full_chat[#full_chat].data .. timestamp_tag
            dbg(triggerId, "BACKUP_SAVED", "ts=" .. ts_id)
        end

        current_step = "setChat()"
        setChat(triggerId, #full_chat - 1, full_chat[#full_chat].data)
        if #full_chat > 1 then
            setChat(triggerId, #full_chat - 2, full_chat[#full_chat - 1].data)
        end

        current_step = "generateUI()"
        setChatVar(triggerId, HTML_KEY, generateUI(triggerId, state, settings))

        dbg(triggerId, "DONE", "onOutput 완료, names=" .. #state.names)
    end)

    if not ok then
        local errMsg = "[ERROR at " .. current_step .. "] " .. tostring(err)
        setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_step",   "ERROR")
        setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_detail", "at=" .. current_step .. " err=" .. tostring(err))
        setState(triggerId, "aff_debug_last",   errMsg)
        print("[Affection] " .. errMsg)
    end
end

--- editRequest: LLM에 보내기 직전 (data = 메시지 배열, data[i].content / data[i].role)
--- 1) 모든 메시지에서 이전 턴 잔여물 제거
--- 2) 마지막 user 메시지에 injection payload 덧붙이기
listenEdit("editRequest", function(triggerId, data)
    if not data then return data end

    -- 마지막 user 인덱스 찾기
    local last_user_idx = nil
    for i = #data, 1, -1 do
        if data[i].role == "user" then
            last_user_idx = i
            break
        end
    end

    -- 모든 메시지 정리
    for i = 1, #data do
        local content = data[i].content
        if content and type(content) == "string" then
            content = content:gsub(REPORT_PATTERN, "")
            content = content:gsub("<curchatID:%d+:curchatID>", "")
            content = content:gsub("<social_report_instruction>.-</social_report_instruction>", "")
            content = content:gsub("<social_dynamics>.-</social_dynamics>", "")
            content = content:gsub("```json%s*", "")
            content = content:gsub("```%s*", "")
            content = content:gsub("|aff_mod\n", "")
            content = content:gsub("\naff_mod|", "")
            content = content:gsub("|aff_inject|", "")
            data[i].content = content
        end
    end

    -- 마지막 user 메시지에 payload 덧붙이기
    if last_user_idx then
        local payload = getState(triggerId, "aff_injection_payload") or ""
        if payload ~= "" then
            data[last_user_idx].content = data[last_user_idx].content .. "\n" .. payload
        end
    end

    return data
end)

--- editDisplay: 유저 화면에서 시스템 요소 숨기기
listenEdit("editDisplay", function(triggerId, data)
    if not data then return data end
    local cleaned = data:gsub(REPORT_PATTERN, "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<curchatID:%d+:curchatID>", "{{#if {{greater_equal::{{chat_index}}::{{? {{lastmessageid}} }}}}}}{{getvar::aff_html}}{{/if}}")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<social_report_instruction>.-</social_report_instruction>", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<social_dynamics>.-</social_dynamics>", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("```json%s*", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("```%s*", "")
    -- 마커 제거
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("|aff_inject|", "")
    cleaned = strip_markers(cleaned) or cleaned
    return cleaned
end)
